s: For which field Shri Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy got Padma Vibhushan Award?
How many Padma Awards were announced for 2026?
x: A total of 131 Padma Awards were announced for 2026. The figure 113 refers specifically to Padma Shri awards, not the overall total.

s: How many posthumous awardees were there in the Padma Awards 2026?
x: There were 16 posthumous awardees; 19 was the number of women awardees and 6 of foreign awardees.

s: Of the 11 Padma Awards 2026 awardees from the Telugu states, how many were from Andhra Pradesh?
x: The Telugu states had 11 awardees: 4 from Andhra Pradesh and 7 from Telangana.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Padma Shri awardees from Andhra Pradesh?
x: Vempati Kutumba Sastry was recognised for Literature & Education, not Science & Engineering.

s: How many Padma Bhushan awards were announced in 2026?
x: The 131 Padma Awards of 2026 comprised 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri.

s: In which field did V. S. Achyuthanandan receive the Padma Vibhushan 2026?
x: V. S. Achyuthanandan was recognised for Public Affairs, not Arts.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Padma Awards?
o: They are announced on Republic Day by the Ministry of Home Affairs
x: The Padma Awards carry no cash prize; the yearly limit of 120 awards excludes posthumous and foreign awardees.

s: What is the yearly limit on Padma Awards, excluding posthumous and foreign awardees?
x: At most 120 Padma Awards are given a year; posthumous and foreign awardees fall outside this limit.

s: During which periods were the Padma Awards suspended?
x: The Padma Awards, instituted in 1954, were suspended in 1978-79 and 1993-97.

s: How many Padma Shri awards were given in 2025?
x: The Padma Shri count was 113 in both 2025 and 2026; only the total fell from 139 to 131.

s: How many foreign awardees were there in the Padma Awards 2026?
x: The 2026 list had 6 foreigners, 16 posthumous awardees and 19 women.

s: Which State is Padma Bhushan 2026 awardee Bhagat Singh Koshyari from?
x: Koshyari (Public Affairs) is from Uttarakhand; Shibu Soren is from Jharkhand and V. K. Malhotra from Delhi.

s: Deepika Reddy of Telangana received the Padma Shri 2026 in which field?
x: Deepika Reddy was honoured in Arts.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Padma Shri 2026 awardees from Telangana:
1. Chandra Mouli Gaddamanugu was honoured in Science and Engineering.
2. Palakonda Vijaya Anand Reddy was honoured in Medicine.
3. Rama Reddy Mamidi was honoured in Arts.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Gaddamanugu (Science and Engineering) and Vijaya Anand Reddy (Medicine) are right; Rama Reddy Mamidi was honoured posthumously under Others (Animal Husbandry).

s: In which field did P. Narayanan of Kerala receive the Padma Vibhushan 2026?
x: P. Narayanan was honoured in Literature & Education; K.T. Thomas and V.S. Achyuthanandan were in Public Affairs.

s: Who among the following received the Padma Vibhushan in 2023?
x: Mathematician S. R. Srinivasa Varadhan got the Padma Vibhushan in 2023; Nageshwar Reddy got it in 2025 and K.T. Thomas in 2026.

s: How many Padma Shri awards went to science and engineering in 2023?
x: In 2023, 8 Padma Shri awards were given in science and engineering.

s: In which year did gastroenterologist Dr D. Nageshwar Reddy receive the Padma Vibhushan?
x: The 2025 Padma Vibhushan list included Dr D. Nageshwar Reddy.

s: Who was awarded the Ashoka Chakra in the 2026 gallantry awards as the Mission Pilot of Axiom-4 to the International Space Station?
x: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla received the Ashoka Chakra as the Mission Pilot of Axiom-4 to the International Space Station. Major Arsheep Singh and Group Captain Prashant Balakrishnan Nair were recipients of the Kirti Chakra, while Lieutenant Commander Dilna K. received the Shaurya Chakra.

s: In which year were India's peacetime gallantry awards, including the Ashoka Chakra, instituted?
x: Peacetime gallantry awards date to 1952, and the Ashoka Chakra can be awarded to civilians as well.

s: Which Ministry instituted the Subhas Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar in 2019?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
x: The award was instituted in 2019 by the Ministry of Home Affairs, not the Ministry of Defence.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Jeevan Raksha Padak awards?
o: The Uttam Jeevan Raksha Padak carries ₹1.5 lakh
The Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak carries ₹2 lakh
The Jeevan Raksha Padak carries a cash award of ₹2 lakh
x: ₹2 lakh is the cash award of the Sarvottam category, not of the Jeevan Raksha Padak.

s: What is the cash award of the Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak?
x: Sarvottam carries ₹2 lakh, Uttam ₹1.5 lakh and the Jeevan Raksha Padak ₹1 lakh.

s: Which Gaganyaan astronaut received the Kirti Chakra in 2026?
x: Prashant B. Nair, a Gaganyaan astronaut, got the Kirti Chakra; Shubhanshu Shukla got the Ashoka Chakra.

s: On which vessel did Lt Cdr Dilna K. and Lt Cdr Roopa A. circumnavigate the globe, earning the Shaurya Chakra 2026?
x: The two naval officers were honoured for their circumnavigation on INS Tarini.

s: What cash prize does the institutional winner of the Subhas Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar receive?
x: The institution gets ₹51 lakh and the individual ₹5 lakh.

s: When was the Jeevan Raksha Padak series of civilian life-saving awards instituted?
x: The Jeevan Raksha Padak awards were instituted on 30 September 1961.

s: Who won the individual category of the Subhas Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar 2026?
x: Lt Col Sita Ashok Shelke of Maharashtra won the individual award (Rs 5 lakh); Sikkim SDMA won the institutional award.

s: Which institution won the institutional category of the Subhas Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar 2026?
x: The Sikkim SDMA won the institutional award, which carries Rs 51 lakh.

s: Who among the following received the Kirti Chakra in the 2026 gallantry awards?
x: The three Kirti Chakras went to Major Arsheep Singh, Naib Subedar Doleswar Subba and Group Captain Prashant B. Nair; Shukla got the Ashoka Chakra.

s: Who received the 'International Culture Award' in 2024?
Which award did Indian-origin American astronomer Srinivas Kulkarni receive from the Royal Astronomical Society?
o: Officer of the Order of Australia
x: Srinivas Kulkarni received the Royal Astronomical Society Gold Medal, an award given since 1824. He had earlier received the Shaw Prize in 2024, but that is distinct from the RAS Gold Medal.

s: PM Narendra Modi became the first Indian Prime Minister to receive which honour of Israel?
o: Grand Collar of the State of Palestine
x: Modi is the first Indian PM to receive the Speaker of the Knesset Medal and to address the Knesset; the Grand Collar of Palestine (2018) was a separate earlier honour.

s: At which event did Rouble (Rubal) Nagi receive the Global Teacher Prize?
x: The prize was presented at the World Governments Summit in Dubai; it was $1 million, meant for free vocational training.

s: Which body established the Crawford Prize, won by Veerabhadran Ramanathan?
o: Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters
x: The Crawford Prize was established by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences and covers fields outside the Nobel, including earth sciences.

s: According to Veerabhadran Ramanathan, CFCs trap about how many times more heat than CO₂?
x: Ramanathan found that CFCs trap about 10,000 times more heat than CO₂.

s: Dr. Chandrakant Lahariya received the Wiley Research Heroes Award 2025 in which category?
x: He won in the 'Impact Beyond Academia' category, the only Indian among five winners chosen from over 2,000 nominations.

s: Which British-Indian actress was made a Dame in the New Year Honours by King Charles III?
x: Actress Meera Syal was made a Dame; geneticist Prof. Meena Upadhyay was also made a Dame.

s: Who became the first mathematician to win the New South Wales Scientist of the Year award in 2025?
x: Indian-origin mathematician Prof. Nalini Joshi became the first mathematician to win the New South Wales Scientist of the Year award. Her field is integrable systems, and she was the first woman Professor of Mathematics at the University of Sydney.

s: Which of the following pairs about Prof. Nalini Joshi is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: First woman Professor of Mathematics – University of Sydney
Order associated with her distinction – Order of Australia
Year she was made an Officer – 2016
x: Prof. Nalini Joshi's field is integrable systems, not number theory.

s: Who was honoured with the Asian Productivity Organization (APO) National Award?
x: Bakul Limbasia, founder of Bhatwari Technologies, received the APO National Award. BVR Mohan Reddy was associated with the Geospatial World ‘Living Legend’ Award, and Abbagauni Nandini with the Nari Shakti Award.

s: Who received the Nari Shakti Award from the Indian Embassy in Doha during Pravasi Bharatiya Diwas?
x: Abbagauni Nandini, a Telangana expatriate native of Shamirpet in Medchal, received the Nari Shakti Award from the Indian Embassy in Doha. Bakul Limbasia and BVR Mohan Reddy received different awards, while Vipul was identified as the ambassador.

s: Who presented the Speaker of the Knesset Medal to PM Modi?
x: The medal, Israel's highest parliamentary honour, was presented by Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana.

s: In which year did PM Modi receive the Grand Collar of the State of Palestine?
x: The Grand Collar of the State of Palestine (2018) makes Modi a rare leader honoured by both Israel and Palestine.

s: Which organisation awards the Global Teacher Prize?
x: The $1 million Global Teacher Prize is given by the Varkey Foundation, founded by Sunny Varkey.

s: Rouble Nagi is the second Indian to win the Global Teacher Prize. Who was the first?
x: Ranjitsinh Disale won in 2020; Rouble Nagi is the second Indian winner.

s: What is the name of Rouble Nagi's project that uses murals on slum walls as classrooms?
x: Her foundation runs about 800 education centres and the project 'Living Walls of Learning'.

s: Which of the following fields, not covered by the Nobel Prize, does the Crawford Prize recognise?
x: The Crawford Prize (est. 1980) covers fields outside the Nobel, including earth sciences.

s: In which year was the Royal Astronomical Society, which gave its Gold Medal to Srinivas Kulkarni, founded?
x: The RAS was founded in 1820 in London; its Gold Medal dates from 1824.

s: Uday Nagraju, sworn in as a life member of the UK House of Lords, hails from which State?
x: Uday Nagraju is from Shanigaram, Siddipet, Telangana; he took the oath on the Bhagavad Gita.

s: Which country conferred the 'Order of Oman (First Class)' on PM Narendra Modi in December 2025?
x: Sultan Haitham bin Tarik of Oman conferred the Order of Oman (First Class) on PM Modi in Muscat on 18 December 2025.

s: Who conferred the Order of Oman (First Class) on PM Modi in Muscat in December 2025?
o: Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani
x: Sultan Haitham bin Tarik presented the honour on 18 December 2025; the order was instituted in 1970 by Sultan Qaboos.

s: In India, the work of the Asian Productivity Organization (APO) is run by which body?
x: The APO (est. 1961, Tokyo) works in India through the National Productivity Council under DPIIT.

x: The 70th Filmfare Awards South were held in Kochi, Kerala, with Kerala Tourism.

o: He won his first Grammy for Music by John Williams and completed the EGOT.
He won Album of the Year for Music by John Williams.
He hosted the ceremony for the 7th and final time.
He accepted the Dalai Lama's first Grammy.

s: In which city was the Ajanta Ellora International Film Festival, where Ilaiyaraaja received the Padmapani Award, held?

x: Hamnet was Best British Film; One Battle After Another was Best Film.

s: Who led the nominations at the 68th Grammy Awards with 9?
x: Kendrick Lamar led with 9 nominations; Bad Bunny won Album of the Year.

s: Which of the following pairs (70th Filmfare Awards South) is correctly matched?
x: Amitabh Bachchan won Supporting Actor for Kalki 2898 AD; Critics' Best Actor was Teja Sajja, Music Album Devi Sri Prasad and Critics' Best Actress Kajal Aggarwal.

s: Who received the Padmapani Award at the Ajanta Ellora International Film Festival 2026?
x: Ilaiyaraaja got the Padmapani Award; Javed Akhtar and Om Puri are past winners.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2023:

I. Daniel Barenboim was announced as winner of the Indira Gandhi Prize for 2023 for his efforts to solve economic crisis and his contribution in the development of Sri Lanka.

II. Ali Abu Awwad was announced as winner of the Indira Gandhi Prize 2023 for his efforts towards a non-violent resolution of the Israel-Palestine conflict.

III. The International Jury of the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2023 was chaired by former Chief Justice of India, R.M. Lodha.
Which among the above given statements are incorrect?
x: The 2023 Indira Gandhi Prize went jointly to Barenboim and Ali Abu Awwad for Israel-Palestine peace efforts (not Sri Lanka), and the jury was chaired by T.S. Thakur, not R.M. Lodha, so I and III are incorrect.

s: Anna Chakra, a finalist for the Franz Edelman Award 2026, is a PDS supply-chain initiative of which of the following?
o: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Department of Food and Public Distribution
x: Anna Chakra is the Department of Food and Public Distribution's PDS supply-chain initiative; it was a finalist, not the winner.

s: Which 475-year-old Portuguese-era cathedral in Maharashtra received the UNESCO Asia-Pacific Cultural Heritage Conservation Award 2025?
o: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Vasai
x: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral in Vasai, a 475-year-old Portuguese-era structure, received the award.

s: What cash award did the Indira Gandhi Peace Prize 2025 carry?
x: The prize carried ₹1 crore, not ₹2 crore; its jury was chaired by Shivshankar Menon.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Tyler Prize 2026?
o: Dr Toby Kiers received it for work on underground mycorrhizal fungal networks
The Tyler Prize was established in 1973
It is administered by the University of Southern California
It is administered by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences
x: The Tyler Prize (1973) is administered by the University of Southern California, not the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences.

s: What does the initiative "Equal Partners, Lasting Peace" promote?
x: “Equal Partners, Lasting Peace” promotes gender-responsive peacekeeping, not climate-resilient peacekeeping.

s: Which country is Graça Machel, winner of the Indira Gandhi Peace Prize 2025, from?
x: Graça Machel of Mozambique won the prize, which carries ₹1 crore.

s: Which prize is often called the 'Nobel Prize for the Environment'?
x: The Tyler Prize is called the 'Nobel Prize for the Environment'; the Franz Edelman Award is the 'Nobel Prize of Operations Research'.

s: In 1973, Rajkumari Indira Devi Dhanrajgir became the first Indian woman nominated for the Nobel Prize in which field?
x: The Hyderabad poet was nominated for the Literature Nobel in 1973 by the World Poetry Society Intercontinental.

s: Who among the following is Dr Toby Kiers, winner of the Tyler Prize 2026?
x: Toby Kiers is an American evolutionary biologist honoured for work on mycorrhizal fungal networks.

s: Which body coordinated India's pavilion at BIOFACH 2026 in Nuremberg?
x: APEDA coordinated India's 1,074 sq m pavilion with 67 co-exhibitors.

s: Who won the Tyler Prize in 2015?
x: Madhav Gadgil won the Tyler Prize in 2015; the 2026 prize went to Toby Kiers.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about BIOFACH 2026?
o: It was held in Nuremberg, Germany
India was its 'Country of the Year' after 14 years
India's pavilion was coordinated by APEDA
The APEDA Act came into effect on 13 February 1985
x: The APEDA Act was passed in December 1985 and came into effect on 13 February 1986.

s: With reference to BIOFACH 2026, which of the following statements is NOT correct?
o: India was named the Country of the Year at BIOFACH 2026.
BIOFACH 2026 was held in Nuremberg, Germany, from 10 to 13 February 2026.
India's pavilion was coordinated by the Spices Board.
x: India's pavilion at BIOFACH 2026 was coordinated by APEDA, not the Spices Board. India was the Country of the Year; the fair was held in Nuremberg, Germany, on 10-13 February 2026, and the pavilion (1,074 sq m) had 67 co-exhibitors.

s: Who chaired the jury of the Indira Gandhi Peace Prize 2025, awarded to Graça Machel?
x: The jury for the 2025 prize, which went to Graça Machel of Mozambique, was chaired by Shivshankar Menon.

s: Which body gives the Indira Gandhi Peace Prize?
x: The Indira Gandhi Peace Prize is given by the Indira Gandhi Memorial Trust and carries ₹1 crore.

s: Which award is called the 'Nobel Prize of Operations Research'?
x: The Franz Edelman Award (USD 10,000) is called the Nobel Prize of Operations Research; India's Anna Chakra was a 2026 finalist.

s: Which of the following award – recipient pairs (February 2026) is correctly matched?
o: Bhavya Bharat Bhushan Award – Varkala Vijayalakshmi
National Handloom Excellence Award – Sipra Mukherjee and Mrinmay Pramanik
A.K. Ramanujan Translation Award – N. Rajam and S. Kiran Kumar
ISCR Lifetime Achievement Award 2026 – Prof. Upendra Kaul
x: Prof. Upendra Kaul received the ISCR Lifetime Achievement Award. N. Rajam and S. Kiran Kumar got the Bhavya Bharat Bhushan, Mukherjee and Pramanik the Ramanujan award, and Varkala Vijayalakshmi the Handloom award.

s: In the Telangana Governor Awards for Excellence 2025, who received the award in the category of Women empowerment?
x: Ramadevi Kanneganti received the award in the Women empowerment category. Tadasam Kailas, Dr. Pradyut Waghe and V. Rajanna were associated with Tribal development, Rural health & medical philanthropy and Corporate volunteering respectively.

s: Which scheme replaced the Perform, Achieve and Trade (PAT) mechanism of the Bureau of Energy Efficiency in 2023?
x: PAT was replaced by the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme in 2023; Standards and Labeling and DSM are other BEE initiatives.

s: Who received the Geospatial World ‘Living Legend’ Award at the 25th GeoSmart India Conference?
x: BVR Mohan Reddy received the Geospatial World ‘Living Legend’ Award at the 25th GeoSmart India Conference. Bakul Limbasia and Abbagauni Nandini were associated with other awards, while Vipul was identified as an ambassador.

s: With the President's Police Colour, Sikkim became the ____ State to receive the honour.
x: Sikkim became the 15th State, and the 3rd in the Northeast, to receive the President's Police Colour.

s: Who presented the National Energy Conservation Awards 2025 in New Delhi?
x: President Droupadi Murmu presented the awards, which are instituted by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency.

s: Under which Act did the Bureau of Energy Efficiency become a statutory body on 1 March 2002?
x: BEE was established on 1 March 2002 under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001.

s: Which prize did Andhra Pradesh's APSECM win at NECA-2024?
x: APSECM won the 1st prize among Group II states at NECA-2024.

s: On which date is National Energy Conservation Day, when the National Energy Conservation Awards are presented, observed?
x: NECA 2025 was presented on 14 December 2025, National Energy Conservation Day.

s: In which category was Tadasam Kailas honoured in the Telangana Governor Awards for Excellence 2025?
x: Tadasam Kailas won in Tribal development; Ramadevi Kanneganti won in Women empowerment.

s: Prof. Upendra Kaul, who received the ISCR Lifetime Achievement Award 2026, is known as which of the following?
x: Cardiologist Prof. Upendra Kaul received the award at the ISCR 20th Annual Meeting in Delhi.

s: Who instituted the new Bhavya Bharat Bhushan Award, first given to N. Rajam and S. Kiran Kumar?
x: The award was instituted by Sadhguru and presented at Isha Yoga Centre on Maha Shivaratri; Rajnath Singh was chief guest.

s: For which weaving tradition did Varkala Vijayalakshmi of Telangana receive the National Handloom Excellence Award?
x: She was honoured for Ikat weaving at the NHDC 43rd Foundation Day.

s: The A.K. Ramanujan Translation Award went to the translation of 'I Belong to Nowhere'. Who is the Dalit poet who wrote it?
x: Sipra Mukherjee and Mrinmay Pramanik won for translating Kalyani Thakur Charal's Bengali work.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Telangana Governor Awards for Excellence 2025:
1. They were presented on 26 January at Lok Bhavan by Governor Jishnu Dev Varma.
2. They were instituted in 2024 and carry ₹2 lakh each.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: the awards, instituted in 2024 with ₹2 lakh each, were presented on 26 January at Lok Bhavan.

s: Under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, up to how many units of free electricity a month are given to a household?
x: PM Surya Ghar (February 2024) aims at 1 crore households with up to 300 free units a month.

s: What is the green hydrogen production target of the National Green Hydrogen Mission by 2030?
x: The mission (January 2023, Rs 19,744 crore) targets 5 MMT of green hydrogen a year by 2030.

s: Which body gives the National Energy Conservation Awards, instituted in 1991?
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
x: The NECA are given by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) and presented on 14 December.

s: Who was named BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2025 at its 6th edition?
x: Smriti Mandhana won the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2025 award. Divya Deshmukh, Preeti Paul and Anjali Bhagwat won the Emerging Player, Para-Sportswoman and Lifetime Achievement awards respectively.

s: Who won the Emerging Player award at the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2025?
x: Divya Deshmukh was Emerging Player; Preeti Paul won Para-Sportswoman and Anjali Bhagwat Lifetime Achievement.

s: With which sport is Anjali Bhagwat, BBC ISWOTY 2025 Lifetime Achievement awardee, associated?
x: Anjali Bhagwat received the Lifetime Achievement award for shooting.

s: In which year did hockey Olympian Davinder Singh Garcha receive the Dhyan Chand Award?
x: Garcha got the Dhyan Chand Award in 2021; Manoj Kothari got it in 2005, and 1980 was Garcha's Moscow Olympic gold.

s: Smriti Mandhana, BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2025, led which team to its 2nd WPL title?
x: Mandhana scored 434 runs in the 2025 Women's World Cup and led RCB to its 2nd WPL title.

s: Who won the Para-Sportswoman award at the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2025?
x: Preeti Paul won the Para-Sportswoman award; Smriti Mandhana was ISWOTY 2025.

s: Which of the following about History That India Ignored (2nd ed.) is INCORRECT?
o: It was authored by Prem Prakash, Chairman of ANI.
It was launched by Goa Governor Ashok Gajapathi Raju.
It was published by Vitasta Publishing.
x: The book was launched by Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant, not Governor Ashok Gajapathi Raju.

s: Which of the following book – person pairs is correctly matched?
o: Red Lines Redrawn: Operation Sindoor and India's New Normal – M. Venkaiah Naidu
Chalice of Ambrosia: Ram Janmabhoomi – Surendra Kumar Pachauri
Mukkalaina Swatantryam, Mana Rajyangam – Gen Upendra Dwivedi
x: Chalice of Ambrosia is linked to Surendra Kumar Pachauri. Red Lines Redrawn is linked to Gen Upendra Dwivedi, the Telugu book to M. Venkaiah Naidu, and Palanivelu Guts to Dr. C. P. Palanivelu.

s: Who authored the Telugu book Agni Sarassulo Vikasinchina Kamalam – Droupadi Murmu, launched at Andhra University?
x: Yarlagadda Lakshmi Prasad wrote the book, which was launched at Andhra University.

s: Who authored the novel Ghost-Eye, dealing with reincarnation and Sundarbans conservation?
x: Amitav Ghosh authored Ghost-Eye, published by Fourth Estate.

s: In which year did Amitav Ghosh, author of Ghost-Eye, receive the Jnanpith Award?
x: Amitav Ghosh is the Jnanpith awardee of 2018.

s: Who launched the book 'Red Lines Redrawn: Operation Sindoor and India's New Normal'?
x: Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi launched the book on 22 January 2026.

s: Droupadi Murmu, the first tribal woman President, is which President of India?
x: Droupadi Murmu is the 15th President of India.

s: Who was appointed CEO of NITI Aayog in February 2026, succeeding B.V.R. Subrahmanyam?
x: Nidhi Chhibber was appointed CEO of NITI Aayog after B.V.R. Subrahmanyam. Deepak Gupta was appointed CMD of GAIL, while Uday Kotak became Chairman of GIFT City and Gyaneshwar Kumar Singh chaired the IICA EoDB advisory panel.

s: Whose statue, as the first and only Indian Governor-General, was unveiled at Rashtrapati Bhavan during the inaugural Rajaji Utsav?
x: C. Rajagopalachari was the first and only Indian Governor-General; his statue was unveiled during Rajaji Utsav.

s: Who was appointed chair of the MeitY committee to modernise DigiLocker rules?
x: Ajay Sawhney chairs the committee (including the proposed 'Entity Locker'); Balaraman Ravindran was named to the UN scientific panel on AI.

s: Who was announced Chairman of GIFT City in February 2026, succeeding Hasmukh Adhia?
x: Uday Kotak succeeded Hasmukh Adhia as GIFT City chairman.

s: Who became the first woman Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra?
x: Sunetra Pawar became the first woman Deputy CM of Maharashtra after Ajit Pawar's death.

s: To which body was Prof. Balaraman Ravindran of IIT Madras appointed?
o: UN Independent Scientific Committee on AI
IICA Ease of Doing Business panel
